rows.label: tlk70000048_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Kai's been acting odd lately.
He won't eat with me. Truth is,
I think he's avoiding me.

rows.label: tlk70000048_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Augusto told me, 'At times like this,
give him good food or a woman and
he'll be fine the next day.'

rows.label: tlk70000048_04_msg0003
rows.name:
That would only work for Augusto. He's
practically made of booze, women, and
good food.

rows.label: tlk70000048_04_msg0004
rows.name:
That woke me up. I should listen more
closely to my son, not other people.
